jobs.title: Project Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Excel Fluid Group

Project Solutions Engineer

This is a fulltime first shift position (Monday – Friday) 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM

Position Overview

The Project Solutions Engineer serves as an in-house engineering resource for the Business Development and Project Sales teams, with a focus on reviewing opportunities early, strengthening technical recommendations, and helping move qualified projects from initial review to a clearly scoped, specifiable solution. This role is intended to provide practical engineering judgment, support customer-facing technical credibility, and help give the buyer or specifying engineer confidence in EFG’s design recommendations.

The position supports the BD team by reviewing project information as opportunities come in, commenting on design considerations, identifying risks or gaps, and helping determine whether EFG’s recommended solution is technically appropriate. The role should keep the BD team involved in the customer relationship while reducing the time spent on detailed technical review, design interpretation, and engineering coordination.

For candidates with Professional Engineer licensure, this role may include responsible review and stamping of applicable project work once the individual has developed sufficient familiarity with EFG’s process, standards, products, and internal controls. Use of a professional stamp must be based on sound engineering judgment, proper review, and comfort with the scope of responsibility.

Responsibilities

Duties would include but not limited to:

Review specifications, drawings, and project data early in the opportunity process to evaluate feasibility, application fit, and technical risk.
Provide practical design comments and engineering recommendations that support BD discussions with buyers, engineers, and project stakeholders.
Help translate customer needs, site conditions, and project requirements into technically sound, cost-conscious system solutions.
Assess hydraulic, civil, electrical, structural, and site-specific considerations to identify concerns before proposals or recommendations are finalized.
Prepare early-stage documentation, including technical summaries, design assumptions, equipment recommendations, review notes, and preliminary layouts.
Prepare design reports, engineering review packages, and supporting documentation for review by external engineers or other qualified reviewers.
Participate in client calls, site visits, pre-bid discussions, and engineer-facing conversations when technical credibility or clarification is needed.
Collaborate with Business Development, Project Sales, internal engineering resources, and external subject matter experts to refine defensible system designs, proposal strategy, and project handoff.
Support responsible engineering review of applicable project work, including stamped work where appropriate based on licensure, review standards, and scope of responsibility.
Maintain current knowledge of EFG products, component manufacturers, industry standards, and application best practices.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related engineering discipline required.
Active Professional Engineer license required or strongly preferred; Civil PE or PE with directly relevant water/wastewater, municipal infrastructure, pump station, or site development experience preferred.
5+ years of relevant experience in civil, water/wastewater, pump station, utility, or infrastructure-related engineering preferred.
Demonstrated ability to review plans, specifications, submittals, and project requirements and provide practical engineering recommendations.
Comfortable working directly with Business Development and Sales teams in a fast-moving opportunity environment.
Ability and willingness, where properly licensed and supported by adequate review, to take professional responsibility for applicable engineering work.
Solid understanding of pumps, hydraulics, site layout considerations, and project design coordination.
Excellent technical writing, communication, and judgment skills.

Additional Notes

Limitations and Disclaimer

The above job descriptions are meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required for the positions.

All job requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health and safety of themselves or other employees.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with Federal and State Laws.

Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills and/or abilities. To perform this job successfully, the employee must possess the abilities or aptitudes to perform each duty proficiently. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.

jobs.title: Field Technician
jobs.description:
At Corkyy, we're proud to help great companies find the right people.

The job below belongs to one of our client companies, AERO BridgeWorks, and we're sharing it here so you can discover more opportunities. When you apply, you'll be taken directly to the hiring company's application process. Everything else you see here comes straight from the original job posting, so you can be confident the details are accurate and up to date...

Hello! Welcome to AERO. We are recruiting for experienced and qualified Technicians to join our Team! We are seeking an experienced, organized, and resourceful team player who shares our passion for teamwork, hands-on construction, and aviation.

AERO is an Employee-Owned company which offers tremendous benefits and team comradery. We are a 'first-name' basis company with a close knit, family-friendly culture, and a comfortable work atmosphere. We are technical experts in our industry, and we work hard to deliver for our clients, but we also have fun and take pride in our projects. Feel free to visit our website www.aerobridgeworks.net The Technician role responsibilities generally include; safely install, assemble, align, wire, commission, maintain, and/or repair industrial and aviation-ground support equipment (GSE). The work may include 480V three-phase electrical systems, motors, mechanical drive systems, conveyors, passenger boarding bridges, point-of-use air-conditioning units, ground power units, automatic docking systems (AVDGS) and related heavy aviation equipment.

This position requires hands-on experience with mechanical installation and millwright work, electrical controls, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), circuit boards, and systematic troubleshooting. An AERO Technician must be able to review and understand technical drawings, identify mechanical and electrical faults, have working knowledge and experience with mechanical drive systems, electrical systems, lockout/tagout and ability to safely complete field assignments. It is preferred a candidate has previous working experience to troubleshoot digital and analog circuits, motor starters, variable frequency drives, sensors, PLC input and output and three-phase motor configurations.

Candidates must possess experience and enjoy hands-on work with mechanical elements, working within established tolerances, following specifications and work with high quality within a standard of accuracy. Potentially apply shop mathematics, mechanical principles and precision measurement techniques, electrical calculations and leverage previous experience to help identify solutions to resolve technical construction or equipment installation challenges in the field. Ability to safely lift, position and handle tools, materials, and equipment. Ability to potentially work from ladders, scaffolds, scissor lifts, aerial lifts and to safely work in active indoor and outdoor airport environment. The role requires candidates to maintain valid driver's license, meet applicable TSA and FAA security requirements. Safety is a large part of our company culture, and any candidate should have experience with OSHA and is required to work in a safe manner adhering to applicable safety regulations and codes.

This position has the opportunity to support specialty aviation projects nationwide. This role offers candidates opportunity to live remote with travel to projects at Airports across the United States. We are happy to share details about work rotations, travel benefits and travel requirements during the interview process. We look forward to sharing additional information about our Employee-Owned company, the job description and the requirements during the interview process.

jobs.title: Development Specialist - Event Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Huntsman Cancer Foundation Overview

The mission of Huntsman Cancer Foundation (HCF) is to raise funds to support the mission of Huntsman Cancer Institute. Together, their overarching goal is to understand cancer from its beginnings, use that knowledge to create and improve cancer treatments, relieve the suffering of patients, and provide education about cancer risk, prevention, and care.

Position Overview

Development Specialist – Events and Special
Projects:
This position serves as a public face and community outreach arm for Huntsman Cancer Foundation. This role facilitates advancements in cancer research by planning, coordinating, and organizing high-impact fundraising events and community activities. A primary focus of this position is growing, sustaining, and supporting the Huntsman Heroes running and cycling teams through year-round athlete engagement, targeted recruitment, and support through each training season. The ideal candidate is a creative, solution-oriented team player, who is highly self-motivated and organized. They excel at building relationships with participants, donors, volunteers, and sponsors in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Huntsman Heroes Team Growth & Sports Event Management

Program Growth

Support the strategic growth, participant recruitment, and program development of the Huntsman Heroes team and associated partnering events.
Partner with running ambassadors and coaches to promote the team at year-round events, schedule and host lunch-and-learns with local companies, and expand community outreach. Create and manage a volunteer support team to assist in this effort.
Work directly with team coaches to establish the official schedule for coaches and volunteers throughout the season.

Huntsman Heroes Stewardship:
Communicate regularly with running team members regarding their fundraising status, milestones reached, jersey and incentive options, and race day details. Athlete Support & Training:
Attend weekly Saturday running and cycling training sessions (November through June) to provide logistical and motivational support to athletes and fundraisers. Create and manage a volunteer support team to assist in this effort. Incentives & Branding:
Collaborate on the selection and design of fundraising incentives, team jerseys, and event merchandise.

Event Production & Logistics
End-to-End Execution:
Coordinate day-of logistics for multiple assigned event tasks (including the Gala, Huntsman Cancer Foundation SportsFest, and special projects). Oversee set-up, registration, course layouts, run-of-show scripts, troubleshooting, and clean-up. Volunteer Coordination:
Recruit, train, schedule, and manage event volunteers and committees to ensure seamless operations. Financial Tracking:
Assist in creating and tracking event timelines, expense budgets, and revenue records for all assigned events.

Community Outreach:
Growth:
Always be on the lookout for a potential participant, event sponsor, donor, or volunteer. Work with the members of the Huntsman Cancer Foundation team on how best to place individuals as a Huntsman Cancer Foundation supporter.

Stewardship:
Community & Third-Party Events:
Provide stewardship and public relations support for independent, community-driven fundraising initiatives. Tours and Presentations:
Provide tours of Huntsman Cancer Institute to audiences of all sizes, effectively communicating the organization's mission and the meaningful ways donor and fundraising support contributes to its work. Data Integrity:
Data Input:
Maintain accurate records of all donor interactions, gift processing, processed transactions, and participant data within the foundation database. Tracking Metrics:
Continuously work towards metrics in order to track success, opportunities, and weaknesses among programs.

Marketing & Communications
Campaign & Content Creation:
Write and design training-focused emails, update fundraising toolkits, establish event collateral needed, and author regular Huntsman Heroes social media and/or blog posts. Digital Marketing Support:
Support team messaging for external digital marketing efforts, helping execute organic and paid social media campaigns, Google ads, and digital billboard advertisements. Storytelling & Media:
Identify compelling participant stories to share across media outlets, blogs, and social platforms. Coordinate shot lists for event photographers and videographers during Huntsman Heroes events.

Work Environment and Level of Frequency typically required
Nearly Continuously: Office environment. Physical Requirements and Level of Frequency that may be required
Nearly Continuously: Sitting, hearing, listening, talking.Often: Repetitive hand motion (such as typing), walking, bending, reaching overhead, physical abilities to move and lift boxes.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalency (one year of education can be substituted for two years of related work experience); and demonstrated human relations and effective communication skills required. Experience which includes fundraising, grant and publication writing, planning and implementing special events and programs and a successful track record in raising donations is preferred.

Preferences

Qualifications & Experience

Experience: 1-2 years of experience in non-profit event planning, fundraising, peer-to-peer athletic event coordination, hospitality, customer success, or a related field.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite. Experience with donor databases (e.g., Raiser's Edge), mobile auction/event platforms (e.g., GiveSmart, Goat Events), social media, and website backend maintenance is a plus.
Schedule: Ability to work flexible hours, including required early morning Saturday training sessions from November through June, Saturday events and occasional evening event hours.

Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Exceptional customer service, written, and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational skills with a proven ability to prioritize workloads, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.
Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to philanthropy ethics codes and patient privacy standards.
Demonstrate strength in relationship management.
Strategic thinker with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
A collaborative team player who can operate independently with minimal direction, while actively bringing issues to the larger team to find the best collaborative solutions.

Special Instructions

Requisition Number:
PRN45906B

Full Time or Part Time?
Full Time

Work Schedule Summary:
Normal working schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The position requires flexibility to work outside of normal business hours, including required early-morning Saturday training sessions from November through June, Saturday events, and occasional evening event hours.This is currently a hybrid position, subject to change at any time. The typical schedule is remote on Mondays and Fridays (work from home), with the expectation of working onsite when needed and onsite in the office Tuesday through Thursday
